Overview

My creation from an art class I took at Suffolk County Community College; where we were tasked to create something which is completely abstract and does not exist in reality.

Process / Additional Notes

After straining my mind trying to come up with something which isn't real; I formed my concept idea around irrational geometric structures, and ultimately came up with this.
